title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-07-12
source: Marty Weinberg's 5" 1/4 track Master Audience Reel>HHb CDR-850>CDR>EAC>CDR>EAC>.WAV>TLH>.FLAC

ai_review.summary: Midnight acoustic set with confusing New Riders material; recording quality is uneven and source unknown.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a late‑night, mostly acoustic performance that many listeners find enjoyable, but the presence of New Riders of the Purple Sage material and mixed‑up track ordering detracts from its Dead‑centric appeal. Reviewers note that the electric portions suffer from sound‑quality issues, and the source (soundboard vs. audience) cannot be identified from the comments.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star comment focuses only on date correction, while two zero‑star reviews criticize content and audio quality; overall the show/recording is seen as below average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners report mixed‑up New Riders material and that the electric portion sounds harsh, suggesting limited clarity and possible tape/source issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic midnight set is fun but hampered by confusion over track selection and minimal Dead material, leading to an uneven listening experience.
